Bug 529422 - [sonar] Resolve "instanceof will always return true"

Change-Id: Ied3aa2abbe2512409101930307d19ffd3ef8e1b9
Signed-off-by: René Purrio <rpurrio@itemis.de>
dslRule:
<!id: redundant.instanceof.to.notnull>
<!description: Replaces a redundant 'instanceof' check with '!= null' when the variable's static type is already a subtype of the checked type.>

;;

commitMessage:
Bug 530751 - Use lambdas in org.eclipse.search

Part 1

Change-Id: Ifa78eccabb7bd77dc2bff7069b83e9567ddee562
Signed-off-by: Lars Vogel <Lars.Vogel@vogella.com>
dslRule:
<!id: runnable.anonymous.to.lambda>
<!description: Replaces an anonymous inner class implementing java.lang.Runnable with a lambda expression. This offers a more concise and readable syntax for functional interfaces, available since Java 8.>
<!severity: HINT>
new java.lang.Runnable() {
    @java.lang.Override
    public void run() {
        $statements$;
    }
}
=>
() -> { $statements$; }
;;
summary: Converts `new Runnable() { ... run() { ... } }` to `() -> { ... }`.
dslValidationResult: Parse error at line 5: Expected '=>' or ';;' but found: @java.lang.Override (line 5)

commitMessage:
Bug 517393: Dark theme hyper-link text is dark blue

Dark theme hyper-link text was dark blue on black background in JDT's
Javadoc. The cause is that JDT's CSS contains hard-coded colors for
the links.
To solve this provide a mechanism in HTMLPrinter to replace symbolic
color names with actual color values from the preferences.

A consumer of HTMLPrinter now can you the symbolic names
hyperlinkColor and
activeHyperlinkColor in their stylesheets.
These symbolic names are replaced with
JFacePreferences.HYPERLINK_COLOR and
JFacePreferences.ACTIVE_HYPERLINK_COLOR by HTMLPrinter automatically.

Also fixed: If one changed the theme or color preferences the cached
colors in HTMLPrinter were not updated.

Change-Id: I386c0a7feff6da132b76bd3ff80c91b4fb919b67
Signed-off-by: Matthias Becker <ma.becker@sap.com>
dslRule:
<!id: use-stringbuilder-for-local>
<!description: Replace StringBuffer with StringBuilder for local variables for performance, when thread-safety is not required.>
<!severity: HINT>
new java.lang.StringBuffer($arg$)
:: isAssignedToLocalVariable()
=>
new java.lang.StringBuilder($arg$)
;;
summary: Replaces `new StringBuffer()` with `new StringBuilder()` when assigned to a local variable.
